subject: Implementation mosaic: delegation + proposed timeline
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation mosaic: delegation & timeline questions

Hi Karthik / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Before we lock a go-live window we need a simple, shared plan that maps milestones to owners and dates (we call it a "mosaic" internally). Can you send a draft MAP that shows the critical path items we discussed:
- API credentials & VPC networking (security sign-off)
- Data ingestion transformation presets (sample schema)
- Inference throughput targets & smoke tests
- Cutover and rollback plan

We have a target public launch for Nov 15 but can be flexible if there are blockers. Procurement is starting this week — procurement will need an SOW and a high-level timeline for approvals.

Two quick asks: can you (1) propose milestone owners on your side and (2) share any preferred dates for a 6–8 week implementation sprint? Also send any templates you want us to fill.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Integrations, NovaHealth
Samantha.Lee@novahealth.com

Attachment: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation mosaic: delegation & timeline questions

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clarity. I drafted a compact MAP and put owners against each milestone so procurement and your PMs have a single view. High level:

Proposed 8-week sprint (we can compress to 6 if your team can prioritize data work):
1) Week 1 (Aug 23–29) — Kickoff + network prep: Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer; Owner (NovaHealth): IT/Security
2) Week 2 (Aug 30–Sep 5) — Credentials & certs: Owner (Redwood): Priyom Das; Owner (NovaHealth): Infrastructure
3) Week 3–4 (Sep 6–19) — Data onboarding & transform: Owner (NovaHealth): Data Eng; Redwood support: Ben Carter (CS)
4) Week 5 (Sep 20–26) — Performance tuning & smoke tests: Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole + infra ops
5) Week 6–7 (Sep 27–Oct 10) — Pilot integration + security review: Owners: joint
6) Week 8 (Oct 11–17) — Cutover dry-run; contingency window Oct 18–31 with final live target Nov 15 as requested (allows for compliance/audit buffer)

I've attached a draft spreadsheet (NovaHealth_MAP_draft.xlsx) that mirrors the above with checkboxes and fields for acceptance criteria per milestone. Key decisions we need from you to lock the timeline:
- Which internal NovaHealth role will sign off on the data schema?
- Procurement lead for SOW review (name + email)
- Whether you prefer a 6-week compressed sprint or standard 8-week window

Operational notes:
- We recommend enabling prefix KV caching for chat workloads (low risk) — this will reduce early token cost during pilot.
- If you need a private deployment (VPC) we can start network prerequisites in Week 1; if hosted will be faster but requires exception request for PHI handling.

Can you confirm owners for data schema and procurement? If those are ready, we can lock Aug 23 as the kickoff and I will loop in CS and engineering for a technical pre-check.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: NovaHealth_MAP_draft.xlsx (xlsx)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cNovaHealthMAP

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Implementation mosaic: delegation & timeline questions

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding Samantha's ask and the MAP draft. Short asks for you both:
- Ben: support Data onboarding (Week 3–4). Please confirm you can allocate 0.4 FTE across two sprints and own the acceptance criteria column in the sheet.
- Marissa: own Week 5 performance tuning & smoke tests and coordinate with Infra Ops. Please list two available days in week-of Sep 20 for a focused perf window.

I'll be point for Redwood and will chair the kickoff. Priyom will own credentials/certs and network config.

Please reply with acceptance (or constraints) by EOD Wednesday so I can send a final MAP to NovaHealth and procurement.
